scientific_integrity: An explicit all-graph proof through the compact symmetric-square diagonal pair and a natural integral exterior-square map; exact independent finite cellular checks are supplemental and not a substitute for proof. Previously known group ranks credited to Khan.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected graphs, untwisted Borel–Moore homology of geometric unordered configurations of exactly two distinct points; graph homeomorphisms only. Does not classify ordinary singular homology, noninjective graph maps, other local systems, or integral homology of geometric symmetry quotients. General symmetric-product literature is a residual priority risk.
title: Integral automorphism modules of Borel–Moore two-point graph configurations
